notes: CONTENT: FY2020 (Q4/20 = 14 weeks, FY = 53 weeks ended 3-Jan-2021) comparatives restated on the FLIR-era non-GAAP definition by the 2021 releases. Only adj_oi, adj_ni, segment non-GAAP keys and is.amort_intangibles are given; the GAAP 2020 data are in another file. In 2020 the only adjusting item is 'Acquired intangible asset amortization' (all acquisitions); severance, facility consolidation and acquisition costs in 2020 (e.g. Q2/20 8.6, Q3/20 3.9, Q4/20 10.4, FY 33.3) were NOT excluded. No inventory step-up / transaction items, so seg_items are empty. adj_corp = non-GAAP corporate expense as a positive expense (= GAAP corporate expense). NCI: none in 2020; base = 'Net income'.

FIRST PUBLICATION: Q1/20, Q2/20, Q3/20 and Q4/20 segment non-GAAP OI / amortization tables (Appendix A 'each quarter of 2020') first appeared in the Q2-2021 release (28-Jul-2021, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428521000122/q2-2021earningsrelease.htm) and were repeated unchanged in the Q3-2021 and Q4-2021 releases. Consolidated OI/NI/EPS reconciliations: Q1/20 first in the Q2-2021 release (revised Q1 table, alongside the recast Q1/21); Q2/20 in the Q2-2021 release (also 6M/20: non-GAAP OI 233.1, 15.3%; NI 190.6; EPS 5.04); Q3/20 in the Q3-2021 release (27-Oct-2021, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428521000167/q3-2021earningsrelease.htm; also 9M/20: OI 365.5, 16.1%; NI 292.1; EPS 7.73); Q4/20 and FY2020 in the Q4-2021 release (27-Jan-2022, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428522000008/q4-2021earningsrelease.htm; FY2020 segment table also first there). No later release presents 2020 (the Q1-2022 release covers only Q1/22 vs Q1/21), so these are the latest figures.

ORIGINAL vs RESTATED Q1/20: the Q1-2021 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428521000085/q1-2021earningsrelease.htm) showed Q1/20 'adjusted' figures equal to GAAP (OI 104.0, 13.3%; net income 82.2; EPS 2.17) under the then FLIR-transaction-only definition; restated in the Q2-2021 release to non-GAAP OI 113.6 (14.5%), NI 89.5, EPS 2.36 (recorded).

CHECKS: segment GAAP OI + segment amortization = segment non-GAAP OI; sum of segment non-GAAP OI - corporate = consolidated non-GAAP OI; OI/NI/EPS bridges tie; quarters sum to FY for amortization (38.8), non-GAAP OI (518.9) and NI (431.6); quarterly non-GAAP EPS sum 11.40 vs FY 11.41 (rounding). TAX line derived as after-tax minus pre-tax amortization (company shows no separate tax line).
